subject: Neurology
content: Neurology focuses on disorders of the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves, neuromuscular system, and related neurological functions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurological assessment evaluates mental status, cranial nerves, motor and sensory function, coordination, reflexes, gait, and other neurological functions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: The brain contains interconnected regions responsible for cognition, sensation, movement, autonomic regulation, language, memory, and other functions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: The spinal cord connects the brain with peripheral structures and contains pathways involved in motor, sensory, and autonomic functions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Peripheral nerves carry sensory information toward the central nervous system and motor or autonomic signals toward target tissues.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: The meninges are protective membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord and consist of dura mater, arachnoid mater, and pia mater.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Cerebrospinal fluid surrounds the brain and spinal cord and contributes to protection, buoyancy, and the internal environment of the central nervous system.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurons are specialized cells that receive, process, and transmit information through electrical and chemical signaling.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Synapses are specialized junctions through which neurons communicate with other neurons or target cells using chemical or electrical signaling.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Reflexes are rapid, organized responses to stimuli mediated through neural circuits and can provide information about nervous system function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Stroke occurs when blood flow to part of the brain is interrupted or when a blood vessel in the brain ruptures, causing neurological injury.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Ischemic stroke results from obstruction of blood flow to brain tissue, commonly because of a thrombus or embolus.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Hemorrhagic stroke occurs when a blood vessel in the brain ruptures and bleeding damages surrounding brain tissue.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Major stroke risk factors include hypertension, tobacco use, unhealthy diet, physical inactivity, diabetes, and other cardiovascular risk factors.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Sudden weakness, facial asymmetry, speech difficulty, vision problems, dizziness, or severe neurological symptoms can indicate stroke and require urgent evaluation.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Epilepsy is a chronic neurological disorder characterized by recurrent unprovoked seizures caused by abnormal electrical activity in the brain.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Seizures are episodes of abnormal excessive or synchronous neuronal activity and can produce changes in awareness, movement, sensation, behavior, or autonomic function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Diagnosis of epilepsy relies on clinical history and examination, with investigations such as EEG or brain imaging used when appropriate.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Epilepsy can often be managed with antiseizure medicines and, in selected patients, other treatments such as surgery or specialized therapies.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Headache is a common neurological symptom and includes primary disorders such as migraine and tension-type headache as well as headaches secondary to other conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Migraine is a primary headache disorder characterized by recurrent attacks that may include moderate or severe headache and associated symptoms such as nausea or sensitivity to light and sound.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Tension-type headache is a common primary headache disorder often characterized by pressing or tightening pain of mild to moderate intensity.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Frequent use of acute headache medicines can contribute to medication-overuse headache in susceptible individuals.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Parkinson disease is a progressive neurological disorder affecting movement and may cause tremor, rigidity, slowness of movement, and postural or gait problems.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Tremor is an involuntary rhythmic oscillatory movement and can occur in several neurological disorders.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Ataxia refers to impaired coordination of voluntary movement and may result from disorders affecting the cerebellum, sensory pathways, vestibular system, or other structures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Dementia is a syndrome involving progressive decline in cognitive function that interferes with daily activities and is not a normal part of healthy aging.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Alzheimer disease is the most common cause of dementia and progressively affects memory and other cognitive functions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Vascular dementia results from cerebrovascular disease and can cause cognitive impairment related to damage from vascular events or chronic vascular injury.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Multiple sclerosis is a chronic inflammatory disease of the central nervous system that can produce neurological symptoms from damage to myelin and related neural structures.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Multiple sclerosis can cause visual, sensory, motor, coordination, balance, cognitive, and other neurological symptoms that vary among individuals.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Peripheral neuropathy involves dysfunction or damage of peripheral nerves and may cause numbness, tingling, pain, weakness, or altered reflexes.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Diabetes can damage peripheral nerves and cause sensory symptoms, pain, weakness, or autonomic dysfunction.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Myasthenia gravis is an autoimmune disorder affecting neuromuscular transmission and commonly causes fluctuating skeletal muscle weakness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Guillain-Barré syndrome is an acute immune-mediated disorder of the peripheral nervous system that can cause rapidly progressive weakness.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Meningitis is inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord and can be caused by bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, or other factors.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Encephalitis is inflammation of brain tissue and can result from infectious, autoimmune, or other causes.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurocysticercosis is infection of the nervous system by larval Taenia solium and can cause seizures and other neurological manifestations.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Spinal cord compression can impair motor, sensory, and autonomic function and may require urgent evaluation depending on cause and severity.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Low back pain can have musculoskeletal, neurological, inflammatory, infectious, or other causes, and neurological assessment is important when red-flag symptoms are present.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Electroencephalography records electrical activity of the brain and is particularly useful in evaluating suspected seizures and some other neurological disorders.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Computed tomography provides rapid cross-sectional imaging of the brain and is widely used in acute neurological assessment.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Magnetic resonance imaging provides detailed brain and spinal imaging without ionizing radiation and is useful for many neurological conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Lumbar puncture obtains cerebrospinal fluid for analysis and can support evaluation of selected infections, inflammatory disorders, bleeding, and other neurological conditions.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Brain tumors are abnormal growths within or around the central nervous system and can cause symptoms through tissue invasion, compression, edema, or altered neurological function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Autism spectrum disorder is a diverse group of conditions related to brain development and is characterized by differences in social communication and restricted or repetitive behaviors or interests.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurodevelopmental conditions arise during development and can affect cognition, communication, behavior, learning, motor skills, or adaptive functioning.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Status epilepticus is a prolonged or recurrent seizure state without adequate recovery and is a neurological emergency requiring immediate management.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Raised intracranial pressure can occur from brain swelling, bleeding, mass lesions, or other causes and may compromise cerebral perfusion and neurological function.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Prevention of neurological disease includes control of vascular risk factors, avoidance of tobacco, physical activity, healthy diet, injury prevention, vaccination, and appropriate management of chronic diseases.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurological rehabilitation aims to maximize function, independence, participation, and quality of life after neurological injury or disease.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.

subject: Neurology
content: Neurological care should integrate symptoms, examination findings, investigations, patient goals, functional needs, safety, and appropriate multidisciplinary support.
license: Source-specific reuse terms apply; this record is an original paraphrase with attribution.
